WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    oe.ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) as average_fill
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  WHERE oe.fillcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan
),
timespan_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) as timespan_avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  WHERE oe.fillcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    oa.ordersmark,
    oa.timespan,
    oa.average_fill,
    ta.timespan_avg_fill,
    oa.average_fill - ta.timespan_avg_fill as exceeds
  FROM order_averages oa
  JOIN timespan_averages ta ON oa.timespan = ta.timespan
  WHERE oa.average_fill > ta.timespan_avg_fill
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    fo.ordersmark,
    fo.timespan,
    fo.average_fill,
    fo.exceeds,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fo.timespan ORDER BY fo.average_fill DESC) as rank
  FROM filtered_orders fo
)
SELECT 
  ordersmark,
  timespan,
  average_fill,
  exceeds,
  rank
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY timespan, rank

assumptions.assumption: Orders with NULL timespan values are excluded from results, since they cannot be joined with a timespan-level average in the comparison
